intent: A Path that crosses codemother's inspect wire from under a known root (the caller's cairn checkout or its CairnCommons) arrives as that root plus a relative path, and the answering judge resolves it against its own checkout of the same root. A path under neither root crosses as itself tagged with the caller's host, and is rebuilt only on that same host; on any other host it is refused loudly, never resolved as a missing file.
